The old peer must refuse the original exact auth request; a selected future peer must produce the explicitly finite TEST status without login/logout/version/native-vendor operations.

Do not relax frozen43 tests or use a copied catalog classifier.

Any subsequent original GUI run retains its original wait, click, peer effects, roster/currentness and cleanup checks. This advisory neither creates that run nor substitutes source tests for it.

checks.subject: Immutable collaboration fixture identity
checks.evidence: Complete current ea1 body equals separately fetched fixed9d body; 97e14385, 16,555 bytes. This is the collaboration fixture's own source, not an inferred lifecycle fixture.

checks.subject: Selected peer identity
checks.evidence: The current/fixed9d selected peer is 920b40fa, 32,221 bytes; complete body read. Collaboration source list index zero and provider==='claude' wrapper dispatch bind it.

checks.subject: Exact wrapper custody
checks.evidence: Every selected peer source is realpath/hash checked before import. The same selected executable is used by runtime/template and management entries; no PATH vendor fallback is present in this wrapper.

checks.subject: Saved selection
checks.evidence: team.savedSettings explicitly selects providerId anthropic and model sonnet. Alice is lead; Bob has explicit codex/TEST-model. No alternative Claude saved model is selected.

checks.subject: Runtime/template selection
checks.evidence: The shared templates expression selects model sonnet for Claude and TEST-model for others. Runtime members are templates.slice(0,2); providerTemplates is the same templates array.

checks.subject: Returned fixture model
checks.evidence: emulatedRuntime.savedModel is sonnet. The concrete extra collaboration correction surface is these three value locations, including one shared runtime/template expression.

checks.subject: Peer offered values
checks.evidence: The peer initializes one model with value sonnet and resolvedModel TEST-claude-sonnet. Its stream argv contract already permits TEST-claude-sonnet, so this model correction need not expand accepted model argv.

checks.subject: Host metadata mapping
checks.evidence: Actual ClaudeManagementHost maps row.value to modelId and preserves row.resolvedModel. It uses the profile executable/environment and original finite timeout/custody.

checks.subject: Captured catalog mapping
checks.evidence: Actual readCapturedClaudeStatus maps resolvedModel ?? modelId to launchModel and status.models. This peer's offered launch value is TEST-claude-sonnet, with source claude-sdk; modelId sonnet remains its alias metadata.

checks.subject: Ready catalog authority
checks.evidence: Actual availability branches recognize claude-sdk as first-party, build visible launch values, and require selected models to be in that set. With this ready catalog, sonnet is refused and TEST-claude-sonnet is the offered value. No production fallback relaxation is proposed.

checks.subject: Dialog consumer
checks.evidence: memberModelScope forwards getTeamModelSelectionError for the lead once its provider is not loading. LaunchTeamDialog consumes the resulting modelValidationError and includes it in isDisabled for launch mode. These exact relevant dialog slices were read; a new whole-dialog audit is not claimed.

checks.subject: Management selection
checks.evidence: Collaboration management uses the same Claude wrapper, sdkRevision 0.3.305, custom-directory config namespace, selected management-role environment, timeoutMs 15000 and modelProbeTimeoutMs 30000.

checks.subject: Original auth command
checks.evidence: Actual ClaudeAuthenticationCoordinator.read constructs ClaudeAuthConversation for the selected profile and calls read with the original profile timeout. Conversation.status launches ['auth','status','--json'] through profile.executable.path and retains original close/currentness.

checks.subject: Missing peer auth branch
checks.evidence: Complete current peer has no auth-command branch. Its argv loop requires every argument to match a --flag form, so first argument auth is refused. This is a direct protocol mismatch, regardless of whether another earlier guard might also refuse a particular run.

checks.subject: Independent auth truth preserved
checks.evidence: readCapturedClaudeAuthentication requests claude.auth and validates profile/config/currentness. readCapturedClaudeStatus catches unavailable auth into authenticated=false, verificationState unknown and statusCheckOutcome model_only; SDK account metadata is not substituted as auth proof.

checks.subject: Original UI boundary preserved
checks.evidence: Original collaboration driver first hydrates Optional launch settings containing substring sonnet, then waits up to original 90000 ms for enabled Launch team before its single click. TEST-claude-sonnet still contains sonnet. No driver predicate or deadline change is needed for the proposed model value alignment.

checks.subject: Existing finite test seam
checks.evidence: Entire desktop-emulated-settings.test.ts read. Existing tests use actual ClaudeAuthConversation/Coordinator, private TEST roots, exact executable hashes, finite child timeouts, effect assertions and cleanup. Current kind union is extensions|saved-import, and its wrapper dispatches to those peers plus settings auth; it does not currently prove the selected claudeProviderPeer auth route.

checks.subject: No lifecycle causal substitution
checks.evidence: The source mismatch is independently established for collaboration. This advisory does not claim which blocker was rendered at the original failed observation, that auth was its sole failure, or that correcting these values will make the whole collaboration flow pass.

checks.subject: Minimal TEST-only scope
checks.evidence: A possible coherent parent-selected repair includes the existing collaboration fixture's three Claude model locations plus the already shared selected TEST peer's finite auth-status support. Production auth/catalog/launch authority and frozen 149/43/85 remain untouched; this advisory selects no patch or execution.

checks.subject: Read-only boundary
checks.evidence: No shell, local runtime, compilation/import/evaluation of target source, source/control/worktree/ref/PR/CI mutation, live polling, new vendor process, retry, deadline increase, test filter, new venue or gate was performed.

conclusion: A coherent shared TEST-only repair can include the existing collaboration fixture, because its own source proves both contracts are inconsistent. Keep production authority and original GUI deadlines unchanged. Parent must select and author any concrete R1/postimages; this report is only the requested bounded source advisory.
